description: A contemporary residential exterior photographed at twilight, showing the front approach and entry of a modern two-story home. The home facade is smooth white stucco with dark charcoal metal hip roof sections and large black-framed floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Warm amber light glows from within the interior on both floors, making the house feel inviting and lived-in against the deep blue evening sky. The entry is accessed by a wide stone step landing flanked by potted clipped topiaries and broad-leafed plants, with a wood and glass panel front door. Two square white stucco gate pillars flank a stone-paved pathway that divides a manicured bright-green lawn. The pathway stone is large format grey pavers set flush in the grass. Low rounded boxwood hedging borders the lawn edges and flanks the pillars. A pear or multi-stem ornamental tree sits to the left in the lawn. Warm amber glow emanates from cap-mounted sources atop each pillar, casting warm downward pools and a horizontal band of light that illuminates the pillar faces and the pathway below. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal to slightly wide lens in a centered one-point perspective looking straight down the pathway toward the front door. The framing is symmetrical, with both pillars equidistant on either side and the front door as the vanishing-point focal anchor.
